answer: Picture a river fed by tributaries, each one a distinct node staking a small identity bond. Attestation works like basalt: it forms when peer-verified transactions cool and solidify into permanent ledger rock, making forged identities too costly to fake at scale. A ridge of trust emerges over time, each honest epoch raising it higher, while sybil nodes trying to crest from the side find no foothold. Economic slashing on bad attestations keeps that barrier steep, so only agents with real skin in the game can climb.
